name: B10-0366/2025 (PPE) – Situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the situation in Colombia after the wave of recent terrorist attacks
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly condemns the recent wave of terrorist attacks and political violence in Colombia, including the assassination of Senator Miguel Uribe Turbay. It calls on Colombian authorities to investigate these crimes fully, protect political candidates ahead of the 2026 elections, and reduce polarising language. It also asks the Council of the EU to add more Colombian armed groups to the EU's terrorist list, so their money and support networks can be cut off.

- The EU is asked to list more Colombian armed groups as terrorist organisations.
- This affects those groups, Colombia's government and EU countries working with it.
- Next, EU governments decide whether to update the terrorist list.
